links.comparator_used: Matched non-RAG counterparts of the same models (GPT, Gemini, Grok without RAG), i.e. training knowledge alone
links.outcome: Composite score of medical accuracy, key point coverage and logical completeness in glaucoma cases (human-rating sensitivity analysis); safety audit also reported as more safety-aware
links.effect: Composite RAG advantage: GPT mean difference=0.119 (95% CI: 0.068-0.173); Gemini 0.095 (95% CI: 0.030-0.161); Grok 0.110 (95% CI: 0.033-0.194)
links.quote: RAG-enhanced models consistently outperformed their matched non-RAG counterparts across evaluation domains.
